{{Top|leg}}
A '''pipe organ''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical instrument]]. [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] kept a massive one in the music room of his [[Fort Tusken/Legends|home]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When [[operative]]s of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] eventually found Tallon, they were brought before him in his music room. As he met them, Tallon played a melancholic tune from the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>
